transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Nisha. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Nisha, I'm Emily Reddy. I am absolutely furious about my latest bill. I've been overcharged by forty dollars and this is the third time this has happened!
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you've had this experience, Ms. Reddy. I can certainly understand why you're so frustrated with these recurring charges.
Agent: Before we dive into the account details, could you please provide me with your account number?
Customer: It is 77264814. My phone number is 94145 70548 and my email is emily.85@examplemail.com.
Agent: Thank you for that information. Let me take a look at your billing history. One moment please.
Customer: I just don't see why I have to keep calling in. If this isn't fixed now, I'm just going to cancel my service and switch to another provider.
Agent: I completely understand. Looking at the bill, I see the error. There is a duplicate charge for the premium data package. I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge right now.
Agent: Please keep in mind that this credit is subject to approval by our billing department and typically takes 7-10 business days to appear on your statement.
Customer: Okay, as long as it gets sorted. I appreciate you actually finding the mistake quickly.
Agent: You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Customer: No, that's all I needed. Thank you for your help, Nisha.
Agent: It was my pleasure. To summarize, I've submitted the refund request for the duplicate charge. Thank you for choosing Nimbus Telecom. Goodbye!
